title: 2123 Prairie: a brownstone front, a stone bow, a slated mansard
items: 2123 Prairie is rebuilt from its rough draft. It is now a brick house with a brown stone front, read off the 1911 fire-insurance map and the right-hand edge of the Armour photograph: a stone bow on the north half of the front, round-headed windows on both floors, a deep cornice, and a slated mansard with dormers and iron cresting round its top. The two-storey back range stands behind it.
